name: An Evening with Aldo
source:
A snowstorm is raging and unfortunately you, a traveller wandering the forests of Gotha, get caught in it. Luckily, you meet a stranger generous enough to give you some shelter till the storm subsides.

So, you spend an evening with the Lord of Gotha. But is there something more than what meets the eye?

[From [url=https://rongbirong.itch.io/an-evening-with-aldo]itch.io[/url]]
